Tier-2 for febio::heat#6. Three failing branches, each reading SUCCESS first and then naming the constant: no block and 0 both give 'A positive universal gas constant R must be defined in Globals section'; 0 gives the matching T message. The fourth branch is the one that matters for a wrapper: omitting only

is NOT an error — the run reaches normal termination and prints the WARNING 'The referential absolute pressure P is calculated internally as '. Positive control: the shipped heat_3d_bar / biphasic_3d_confined template, unmodified, which runs to normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
